name: rammetto_one
description: Rammetto is a typeface based on the Stephenson Blake uppercase display font, Basuto, released in 1926. The Rammetto design refines some of the old font's forms, introduces a full set of lowercase characters and adds extended support for European languages. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/RammettoFont .
